hints: The laptop tells you where the intranet lives. Open that address in your own browser - any browser will do.
Once you're logged in, open a ticket and watch the address bar. That number at the end - what happens if you change it?
Try ticket ids just above and below 1042 in ?id=. The facilities ticket from the maglock vendor holds the override token; copy it exactly into the laptop's flag field.
challenges.title: Kestrel Intranet

difficulties.description: The classic room. You hack a real web app, but the password is out there to find.
difficulties.title: Standard

difficulties.description: Mark rotated his password. Crack it from the backup on his USB stick with your own tools (John the Ripper or hashcat), then hack the intranet.

hack_intranet.gm_notes: Hard mode. Office/Pinboard/WifiCardHard replaces the WiFi card (its back says the password was rotated). The USB stick in the filing cabinet (so this thread now needs open_cabinet) carries shadow.bak; the mreyes line is sha512crypt of Kestrel#2019. Office/Pinboard/PasswordPolicy gives the pattern Word + symbol (! # $ % & *) + join year; Office/Pinboard/AnniversaryCard gives 2019. The intranet locks mreyes for 3 minutes after 5 wrong passwords, so online guessing is slow. Players need their own cracker (John, hashcat -m 1800, or an openssl passwd loop).
hints: Mark finally rotated his password, so that WiFi card is no help now. But Mark backed everything up - and his backups are locked in the filing cabinet.

The USB stick holds a copy of the intranet server's password file: save it to your computer. The IT policy on the pinboard says how passwords are built here, and Mark's anniversary card says when he joined.

Make a wordlist from the room (start with the company name) + one of ! # $ % & * + 2019, and crack the mreyes hash with John the Ripper or hashcat (mode 1800). Don't guess on the login page: five misses lock the account. If you're stuck: it's Kestrel#2019.

difficulties.title: Hard

puzzles.gm_notes: First solve, meant to land within 2-3 minutes. Office/Desk/Drawer is an unlocked ContainerProp; the UV torch (Office/Desk/Drawer/Slide/Contents/UVTorch) lies under decorative papers. If players stall, push them towards the desk.
hints: Dale here, security. Mark - your sysadmin - always kept his gadgets close to hand. I'd start with his desk.
The top drawer of Mark's desk never locks. Have a rummage under the papers in there.
Open the top drawer of the desk and pick up the UV torch lying under the papers.
puzzles.title: Find the UV torch

puzzles.gm_notes: The code is the per-session variable cabinet_code (4 digits), shown by the UVReveal Office/Whiteboard/UVInk only while a player has the UV torch selected and is within 2.5 m. The marker note on the board points at it. Enter it on Office/FilingCabinet/Keypad, then open the cabinet drawer: laminated network diagram (patch mapping, needed for restore_power) and a USB stick holding shadow.bak (needed in hard mode, where Mark's password has to be cracked from it).
hints: That filing cabinet takes a four-digit code. Mark never wrote codes anywhere you could just read them.
Mark had a thing for invisible ink. Select the UV torch and stand at the whiteboard, near his note about the filing cabinet.

With the UV torch selected, stand within a couple of metres of the whiteboard: four violet digits glow to the right of the 'Filing cabinet code' note. They change every shift, so read them off the board and type them left to right into the cabinet keypad.
puzzles.title: Open the filing cabinet

puzzles.gm_notes: Parallel thread from minute one. Clues: sticky note (Office/Desk/StickyNote, user mreyes) and the back of the Guest WiFi card (Office/Pinboard/WifiCard, password Kestrel#2019). The laptop (Office/Desk/Laptop, remote Terminal) shows the connection card; players use their own browser. Tickets page uses ?id=1042; neighbouring ids (IDOR) reveal the maglock vendor's facilities ticket with the per-session flag. Submitting it fires Cage/FlagGate, which releases Cage/Door/Maglock.
hints: Mark's laptop is still on. If you can get into the intranet, maybe the maglock people left something useful on a ticket.
Mark's username is on the sticky note on his monitor, and he reused a password. That Guest WiFi card on the pinboard - flip it over.

Log in as mreyes with password Kestrel#2019. Open a ticket, then change the ticket number in the address bar to look at the neighbouring tickets. The maglock vendor's ticket has an override token: paste it into the laptop's flag field.
puzzles.title: Get into the Kestrel intranet

puzzles.gm_notes: Inside the cage (Cage/PatchPanel). The mapping A:3, B:7, C:1, D:5 comes from the network diagram in the filing cabinet. Cables are labelled by letter plus stripe count (A one stripe, B two, C three, D none), never colour alone. Solving it powers the exit override panel (Office/ExitDoor/Keypad): the panel's status changes from blank to LOCKED.
hints: The door panels run off the mains, and the mains are gone. That UPS in the cage could carry them if it were cabled up right.
There's a patch panel on the rack in the cage with four loose cables. The laminated network diagram from the filing cabinet says where each one goes.
On patch panel P1: cable A to port 3, B to port 7, C to port 1, D to port 5. The cables are tagged by letter and by stripe count, not just colour.
puzzles.title: Put the door panels on the UPS

puzzles.gm_notes: Meta puzzle. Plate above the exit keypad: "MAGLOCK OVERRIDE: SITE + RACK". SITE 417 is on Office/FireCertificate (readable from the start); RACK 062 is on Cage/RackStencil (visible through the cage mesh, readable up close once inside). Code 417062. Unlocking the panel ends the session with a win; the exit door then opens.
hints: Once the exit panel lights up it wants an override code. The plate just above it tells you how the code is built.
SITE plus RACK. The site number is on the fire inspection certificate on the office wall; the rack number is stencilled on the rack inside the cage.
Type 417062 on the exit door override panel: site 417, then rack 062.
puzzles.title: Override the exit maglock
